text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On the way back from an errand. I spotted Nice Nature and
the others in an unexpected place, so I went to ask them about it—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, this is part of my research!
It's a long story, but..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
My little bro drew a picture of us
as a present, and honestly...
he did a pretty darn good job on it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
We were all talking about wanting to say thanks, y'know?
So we decided to make a cake or something.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
For that reason, I'm studying how to look photogenic.
...See, kids around that age love flashy,
sparkly things.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I see... In that case,
I'll help out too!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, shall we begin the concerto!
Play to your heart's content! First, in rubato!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Earth!? You really should measure
the granulated sugar! You're eyeballing it way too much!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Look, Machitan! I put in tons of cocoa powder
and it turned pitch black!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Awawa... The batter has turned into quite a mess...
Well, but with a rich flavor, it might actually taste good?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"What is... this...? We were supposed
to be making a cake, weren't we?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
B-Baking sweets is delicate work!
Mess-ups are totally normal! Let's move on to the next one!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm.
It looks like a cake, but...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: So plain! This isn't any different from a totally normal cake!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Right...? But with our abilities,
we can't do any more than this...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...No. Let's push a little harder.
I'm sure Nature-san and the others can do it!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Turbo, you like drawing illustrations, right?
Could you decide on the overall concept?
Then everyone can work together to recreate it—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A doloroso melodía...!
Ah, I cannot convey my amoroso like this!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The difficulty level really shot up for decorating...
But making the batter and all that is already flawless!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best! One more time!
Next time's gonna work out for sure!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I think this is way better than the last one!
With this... we could probably call it complete, right?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Look at this, Nature! Right here!
It's a little different from Turbo's drawing!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, you know.
Let's just call it a bit of charm."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...I mean, maybe if we tried a few more times
we could make a perfect one, but...
look, curfew's coming up soon, and—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I know you, Nature-san.
You're not the type to "give up" here.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Shion-san...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'll stick with you until the very end!
So let's go all the way until we're satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—If it's you guys, you'll definitely pull it off.
I believe in ya!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...W-What do you think? This...!
Personally, I'm feeling really good about it!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Braviiiiisssimo!!!
A melodia con amore!!
This truly is the finest musica to send to my young brother!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Heheh... I'm glad it went well.
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to your encouragement.
It's all thanks to your encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“...That might be part of it too.
Though I'm just parroting what I heard—”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: When my efforts still fell short... you still praised me for trying so hard.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "Well, it motivated me... so I just did the same thing for everyone else."
choice_data_list: I see. So that's how it was...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Trainer.
Thanks to you, I—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I've finally become someone who can cheer up my friends!
choice_data_list: It's admirable how you can turn praise into strength
...The look on your face has changed a little.
...The look on your face has changed a little.
I'm glad my words reached you properly.
I'm glad my words reached you

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I've finally become someone who can cheer up my friends!
choice_data_list: It's admirable how you can turn praise into strength
...The look on your face has changed a little.
...The look on your face has changed a little.
I'm glad my words reached you properly.
I'm glad my words reached you

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's not me. What's amazing is your character,
someone whose dedication to hard work deserves praise.
choice_data_list: No, no... Just thinking that way is admirable enough!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no... Trainer, it's your humble attitude
that's truly admirable—
choice_data_list: No, no, no, Shion is the one who...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, no, no, you're the one who's... Trainer...
...Pfft."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! This is never gonna end, is it?
Let's just say you're both awesome.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... You think so?
—Yeah, I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: How should I put it... Even if her core hasn't changed... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I've gotten a little more positive... or something.
Just a tiny bit, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I've come to be able to think that way. Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Y-You're happy about that?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Because it means they listened earnestly.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah... I see. That's how it is...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course.
They're your words, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ……You're always saving my skin. Really.
